description: This file contains utility functions for shell scripting, including variable retrieval, setting variable contents to a file, and checking if a variable is set.

methods.name: getvar
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a variable whose name is passed as an argument.

methods.name: var2file
methods.description: Stores the value of a variable into a specified file.

methods.name: isset
methods.description: Checks if a variable is set and non-empty.
